user_request: Build an AI document intelligence platform using AWS. It should allow users to upload PDF documents securely, extract text using OCR, identify PII, and store the metadata in a graph database for relationship querying.
normalized_request: Build an AI document intelligence platform that enables secure PDF upload, optical character recognition (OCR) text extraction, personally identifiable information (PII) detection, and relationship-based metadata storage and querying using a graph database.

requirements.description: Users must securely upload PDF documents with encryption in transit and at rest
Extract text content from PDF documents using OCR to handle both digital and scanned PDFs
Detect and classify personally identifiable information (PII) within extracted text
Store document metadata and relationships in a graph database for entity and relationship queries
Provide query interface to traverse relationships between documents, entities, and extracted information
Manage user authentication and authorization to control document access

components.name: SECURE_FILE_UPLOAD_HANDLER
components.description: Manages secure PDF document upload with encryption, virus scanning, and storage integration

components.name: OCR_AND_TEXT_EXTRACTION
components.description: Extracts text from PDF documents using optical character recognition for both digital and scanned documents

components.name: PII_DETECTION_AND_CLASSIFICATION
components.description: Identifies and classifies personally identifiable information entities (names, emails, phone numbers, SSNs, etc.) within extracted text using NLP models

components.name: GRAPH_DATABASE_STORAGE
components.description: Stores document metadata, extracted entities, relationships, and PII findings in a graph database for relationship-based queries

components.name: RELATIONSHIP_QUERY_ENGINE
components.description: Provides query interface to traverse and analyze relationships between documents, entities, and PII findings in the graph

components.name: REST_API_BACKEND
components.description: Exposes endpoints for document upload, processing status, metadata retrieval, and graph queries

components.name: AUTHENTICATION_AND_AUTHORIZATION
components.description: Manages user identity, access control, and document-level permissions to ensure secure multi-tenant access

components.name: DOCUMENT_PROCESSING_ORCHESTRATION
components.description: Coordinates asynchronous workflows across OCR, PII detection, and graph storage for uploaded documents

execution_plan.objective: Break down the AI document intelligence platform into core components: secure PDF upload, OCR text extraction, PII detection, graph database integration, and relationship querying capabilities.

Identify existing AWS services, open-source OCR libraries, PII detection tools, graph database solutions, and related packages that could support document intelligence, PDF handling, text extraction, sensitive data masking, and graph querying.

Assess the maturity, compatibility, licensing, and fit of identified solutions against the requirements for secure uploads, OCR accuracy, PII detection accuracy, graph database performance, and AWS integration.
Determine which components can be REUSED from existing AWS services or packages, which require ADAPTATION for this use case, and which require new BUILD from scratch.

Create a detailed technical blueprint showing AWS architecture, service integration points, OCR/PII pipeline configuration, graph schema design, and implementation workflow for the document intelligence platform.
Validate that the blueprint addresses all functional requirements, security constraints, scalability needs, and cost efficiency for the document intelligence platform on AWS.
